target.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact
target.body:
Closes #98276

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users downloading the CI `dist-runtime-build` artifact for gateway or ACP runtime proof would need local repairs before the artifact could resolve workspace templates and plugin runtime modules.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime artifact now preserves the package-root launcher, package metadata, docs workspace templates, runtime agent templates, and built `dist`/`dist-runtime` outputs in the same archive. This keeps the existing package-root resolvers for `src/agents/templates`, `docs/reference/templates`, and `dist/plugins/runtime` working from the extracted artifact instead of requiring local copies or symlink repairs.

## User Impact

Developers and proof workflows can use the CI runtime artifact as a pinned runtime input with the packaged template and plugin runtime layout present. This does not claim the downstream evaOS visible-agent ACP behavior is fixed; it only fixes the artifact reproducibility gap tracked here.

## Evidence

- Current head: `c84f2784df1a6009c32c34342336d24e3ef37fae`.
- Claim proved: the CI workflow packages the runtime artifact with the package-root runtime resources needed by workspace template and plugin runtime resolution, and the current head keeps the follow-up lint/close-error fixes without changing artifact roots, manifest checks, or smoke behavior.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `git diff --check -- .github/workflows/ci.yml test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts scripts/dist-runtime-build-artifact.mjs` passed locally on the PR worktree.
  - `node --check scripts/dist-runtime-build-artifact.mjs` passed locally on the PR worktree.
  - Earlier current-head author proof on `c84f2784df`: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.scripts.json scripts/dist-runtime-build-artifact.mjs` passed.
  - Earlier current-head author proof on `c84f2784df`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts` passed, 33 tests.
  - Earlier current-head author proof on `c84f2784df`: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.cmd --check --threads=1 scripts/dist-runtime-build-artifact.mjs test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts` passed.
  - Earlier current-head author proof on `c84f2784df`: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit f002d0df1b` was clean, with no accepted/actionable findings.
  - PR check `Real behavior proof` passed on July 2, 2026: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28606714095/job/84828724242.
  - PR checks `check-lint`, `build-artifacts`, Blacksmith Testbox `check`, and Blacksmith ARM Testbox `check-arm` are passing on the PR.
  - Maintainer artifact proof from `0223caf09c`: local `pnpm build:ci-artifacts` passed; local `node scripts/dist-runtime-build-artifact.mjs pack-and-smoke --archive dist-runtime-build.tar.zst` produced `sha256=8252ae210644893218abbcbf254ac281ca32ba9847ab5faeb8c595ea2289cb24`, `entries=13234`, ACP import passed, and Gateway `/readyz` passed with the bundled `browser` plugin loaded; Crabbox remote Azure run `run_412298228807` produced `sha256=72c9f1235f2a9623f014762fb5fda04207a5d225cb3617049fbd2a8386782ee9`, `entries=13234`, ACP import passed, and Gateway `/readyz` passed with the bundled `browser` plugin loaded.
- Observed result: the artifact script/guard path preserves `openclaw.mjs`, `package.json`, `docs/reference/templates`, `src/agents/templates`, `dist`, and `dist-runtime`, while rejecting broad source/package roots outside the runtime-owned template paths; current-head checks show no relevant failed or pending checks.
- Not tested / proof gaps: I did not rerun a full local artifact build/extract smoke in this pass. The current remaining contributor-side blocker was durable PR-body Evidence tying the already-acked current head to the existing proof. Full CI artifact production remains owned by PR CI/maintainer automation.
